fullText.simplified:
跑

    刘备没有等到元少的军队，只能自己带人跟曹操打。但是曹操的人太多了，关羽和张飞还没有回来，曹操就已经打进了徐州城。
    刘备往南跑，是曹操的人，往北跑，还是曹操的人。曹操的人都在找他，他只能一直跑。后来，跟着他一起跑的人越来越少，一直跟着他的妻子也不见了。刘备累极了，也难过极了，国家还是老样子，皇帝也还在等他，自己什么事都没做，现在就要死了，这太让人伤心了。
    张飞很着急，只想快点儿去帮刘备，但没想到曹操带了这么多人，他只能打啊打。终于，他到了徐州城外，但是他跑到哪儿，哪儿就有曹操的人，他找不到刘备和关羽。曹操的人越来越多，张飞没有办法，只能又跑……
    关羽住在下皮城，虽然离刘备很近，但是曹操的人每天都来，他每天都要和曹操的人打，打完以后才能去找刘备和张飞。他找了很多天，一直找不到他们。有一天，他找到了一个女人，她是刘备的妻子。
    关羽着急地问：“您怎么一个人在这儿？大哥呢？”
    刘备的妻子一边哭一边说，她也一直在找刘备，但是怎么也找不到。她不敢说后面的话，她最害怕的事情是刘备已经被曹操杀了。
    关羽伤心极了，带着刘备的妻子回下皮城了。
fullText.traditional:
跑

    劉備沒有等到元少的軍隊，只能自己帶人跟曹操打。但是曹操的人太多了，關羽和張飛還沒有回來，曹操就已經打進了徐州城。
    劉備往南跑，是曹操的人，往北跑，還是曹操的人。曹操的人都在找他，他只能一直跑。後來，跟著他一起跑的人越來越少，一直跟著他的妻子也不見了。劉備累極了，也難過極了，國家還是老樣子，皇帝也還在等他，自己什麼事都沒做，現在就要死了，這太讓人傷心了。
    張飛很著急，只想快點兒去幫劉備，但沒想到曹操帶了這麼多人，他只能打啊打。終於，他到了徐州城外，但是他跑到哪兒，哪兒就有曹操的人，他找不到劉備和關羽。曹操的人越來越多，張飛沒有辦法，只能又跑……
    關羽住在下皮城，雖然離劉備很近，但是曹操的人每天都來，他每天都要和曹操的人打，打完以後才能去找劉備和張飛。他找了很多天，一直找不到他們。有一天，他找到了一個女人，她是劉備的妻子。
    關羽著急地問：“您怎麼一個人在這兒？大哥呢？”
    劉備的妻子一邊哭一邊說，她也一直在找劉備，但是怎麼也找不到。她不敢說後面的話，她最害怕的事情是劉備已經被曹操殺了。
    關羽傷心極了，帶著劉備的妻子回下皮城了。

sentences.simplified: 刘备没有等到元少的军队，只能自己带人跟曹操打。
sentences.traditional: 劉備沒有等到元少的軍隊，只能自己帶人跟曹操打。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi méi yǒu děng dào yuán shào de jūn duì zhǐ néng zì jǐ dài rén gēn cáo cāo dǎ
sentences.english: Liu Bei could not wait for Yuan Shao’s troops and had to lead his own troops to fight Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 但是曹操的人太多了，关羽和张飞还没有回来，
sentences.traditional: 但是曹操的人太多了，關羽和張飛還沒有回來，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì cáo cāo de rén tài duō le guān yǔ hé zhāng fēi hái méi yǒu huí lái
sentences.english: But Cao Cao had too many men, and before Guan Yu and Zhang Fei returned, ..

sentences.simplified: 曹操就已经打进了徐州城。
sentences.traditional: 曹操就已經打進了徐州城。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo jiù yǐ jīng dǎ jìn le xú zhōu chéng
sentences.english: .. Cao Cao had already fought his way into the city of Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 刘备往南跑，是曹操的人，往北跑，还是曹操的人。
sentences.traditional: 劉備往南跑，是曹操的人，往北跑，還是曹操的人。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi wǎng nán pǎo shì cáo cāo de rén wǎng běi pǎo hái shì cáo cāo de rén
sentences.english: If Liu Bei ran south, there were Cao Cao’s men. If he ran north, there were still Cao Cao’s men.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的人都在找他，他只能一直跑。
sentences.traditional: 曹操的人都在找他，他只能一直跑。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de rén dōu zài zhǎo tā tā zhǐ néng yì zhí pǎo
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s men were looking for him, and he had to keep running.

sentences.simplified: 后来，跟着他一起跑的人越来越少，一直跟着他的妻子也不见了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，跟著他一起跑的人越來越少，一直跟著他的妻子也不見了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái gēn zhe tā yì qǐ pǎo de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo yì zhí gēn zhe tā de qī zi yě bú jiàn le
sentences.english: Later, there were fewer and fewer people running with him, and his wife, who had been following him, disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 刘备累极了，也难过极了，国家还是老样子，皇帝也还在等他，
sentences.traditional: 劉備累極了，也難過極了，國家還是老樣子，皇帝也還在等他，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi lèi jí le yě nán guò jí le guó jiā hái shi lǎo yàng zi huáng dì yě hái zài děng tā
sentences.english: Liu Bei was extremely tired and sad. Things were still the same in the country. The emperor was still waiting for him.

sentences.simplified: 自己什么事都没做，现在就要死了，这太让人伤心了。
sentences.traditional: 自己什麼事都沒做，現在就要死了，這太讓人傷心了。
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ shén me shì dōu méi zuò xiàn zài jiù yào sǐ le zhè tài ràng rén shāng xīn le
sentences.english: He hadn’t achieved anything, and now he was going to die. It was heartbreaking.

sentences.simplified: 张飞很着急，只想快点儿去帮刘备，
sentences.traditional: 張飛很著急，只想快點兒去幫劉備，
sentences.pinyin: zhāng fēi hěn zháo jí zhǐ xiǎng kuài diǎn'r qù bāng liú bèi
sentences.english: Zhang Fei was very anxious and just wanted to quickly go and help Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 但没想到曹操带了这么多人，他只能打啊打。
sentences.traditional: 但沒想到曹操帶了這麼多人，他只能打啊打。
sentences.pinyin: dàn méi xiǎng dào cáo cāo dài le zhè me duō rén tā zhǐ néng dǎ ā dǎ
sentences.english: He didn’t expect that Cao Cao would bring so many men. All he could do was keep fighting.

sentences.simplified: 终于，他到了徐州城外，
sentences.traditional: 終於，他到了徐州城外，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú tā dào le xú zhōu chéng wài
sentences.english: Finally, he arrived outside Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 但是他跑到哪儿，哪儿就有曹操的人，他找不到刘备和关羽。
sentences.traditional: 但是他跑到哪兒，哪兒就有曹操的人，他找不到劉備和關羽。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā pǎo dào nǎ'r nǎ'r jiù yǒu cáo cāo de rén tā zhǎo bu dào liú bèi hé guān yǔ
sentences.english: But wherever he ran to, there were Cao Cao’s men, and he couldn’t find Liu Bei or Guan Yu.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的人越来越多，张飞没有办法，只能又跑……
sentences.traditional: 曹操的人越來越多，張飛沒有辦法，只能又跑……
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de rén yuè lái yuè duō zhāng fēi méi yǒu bàn fǎ zhǐ néng yòu pǎo
sentences.english: There were more and more of Cao Cao’s men. Zhang Fei had no choice but to run away again …

sentences.simplified: 关羽住在下皮城，
sentences.traditional: 關羽住在下皮城，
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ zhù zài xià pí chéng
sentences.english: Guan Yu lived in the city of Xiapi.

sentences.simplified: 虽然离刘备很近，但是曹操的人每天都来，他每天都要和曹操的人打，
sentences.traditional: 雖然離劉備很近，但是曹操的人每天都來，他每天都要和曹操的人打，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán lí liú bèi hěn jìn dàn shì cáo cāo de rén měi tiān dōu lái tā měi tiān dōu yào hé cáo cāo de rén dǎ
sentences.english: Although it was close to Liu Bei, Cao Cao’s men came every day, and he had to fight Cao Cao’s men every day.

sentences.simplified: 打完以后才能去找刘备和张飞。
sentences.traditional: 打完以後才能去找劉備和張飛。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán yǐ hòu cái néng qù zhǎo liú bèi hé zhāng fēi
sentences.english: He could only go and look for Liu Bei and Zhang Fei after he had finished fighting.

sentences.simplified: 他找了很多天，一直找不到他们。有一天，他找到了一个女人，她是刘备的妻子。
sentences.traditional: 他找了很多天，一直找不到他們。有一天，他找到了一個女人，她是劉備的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǎo le hěn duō tiān yì zhí zhǎo bu dào tā men yǒu yì tiān tā zhǎo dào le yí ge nǚ rén tā shì liú bèi de qī zi
sentences.english: He searched for many days but couldn’t find them. One day, he found a woman. She was Liu Bei’s wife.

sentences.simplified: 关羽着急地问：“您怎么一个人在这儿？大哥呢？”
sentences.traditional: 關羽著急地問：“您怎麼一個人在這兒？大哥呢？”
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ zháo jí de wèn nín zěn me yí ge rén zài zhè‘r dà gē ne
sentences.english: Guan Yu asked anxiously, “Why are you here alone? Where is my eldest brother?”

sentences.simplified: 刘备的妻子一边哭一边说，她也一直在找刘备，
sentences.traditional: 劉備的妻子一邊哭一邊說，她也一直在找劉備，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi de qī zi yì biān kū yì biān shuō tā yě yì zhí zài zhǎo liú bèi
sentences.english: Liu Bei’s wife cried and said that she had also been looking for Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 但是怎么也找不到。
sentences.traditional: 但是怎麼也找不到。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zěn me yě zhǎo bu dào
sentences.english: But no matter how she looked, she couldn’t find him.

sentences.simplified: 她不敢说后面的话，她最害怕的事情是刘备已经被曹操杀了。
sentences.traditional: 她不敢說後面的話，她最害怕的事情是劉備已經被曹操殺了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù gǎn shuō hòu miàn de huà tā zuì hài pà de shì qing shì liú bèi yǐ jīng bèi cáo cāo shā le
sentences.english: She didn’t dare to continue. Her greatest fear was that Liu Bei had already been killed by Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 关羽伤心极了，带着刘备的妻子回下皮城了。
sentences.traditional: 關羽傷心極了，帶著劉備的妻子回下皮城了。
sentences.pinyin: guān yǔ shāng xīn jí le dài zhe liú bèi de qī zi huí xià pí chéng le
sentences.english: Guan Yu was very sad. He took Liu Bei’s wife back to the city of Xiapi.

sentence_translations: Run
Liu Bei could not wait for Yuan Shao’s troops and had to lead his own troops to fight Cao Cao.
But Cao Cao had too many men, and before Guan Yu and Zhang Fei returned, ..
.. Cao Cao had already fought his way into the city of Xuzhou.
If Liu Bei ran south, there were Cao Cao’s men. If he ran north, there were still Cao Cao’s men.
Cao Cao’s men were looking for him, and he had to keep running.
Later, there were fewer and fewer people running with him, and his wife, who had been following him, disappeared.
Liu Bei was extremely tired and sad. Things were still the same in the country. The emperor was still waiting for him.
He hadn’t achieved anything, and now he was going to die. It was heartbreaking.
Zhang Fei was very anxious and just wanted to quickly go and help Liu Bei.
He didn’t expect that Cao Cao would bring so many men. All he could do was keep fighting.
Finally, he arrived outside Xuzhou.
But wherever he ran to, there were Cao Cao’s men, and he couldn’t find Liu Bei or Guan Yu.
There were more and more of Cao Cao’s men. Zhang Fei had no choice but to run away again …
Guan Yu lived in the city of Xiapi.
Although it was close to Liu Bei, Cao Cao’s men came every day, and he had to fight Cao Cao’s men every day.
He could only go and look for Liu Bei and Zhang Fei after he had finished fighting.
He searched for many days but couldn’t find them. One day, he found a woman. She was Liu Bei’s wife.
Guan Yu asked anxiously, “Why are you here alone? Where is my eldest brother?”
Liu Bei’s wife cried and said that she had also been looking for Liu Bei.
But no matter how she looked, she couldn’t find him.
She didn’t dare to continue. Her greatest fear was that Liu Bei had already been killed by Cao Cao.
Guan Yu was very sad. He took Liu Bei’s wife back to the city of Xiapi.
